morning.insight:
💡 「외국인 2.9조 매도 vs 삼성 1.36조 AI 투자」

외국인이 2.9조를 팔아치우는 와중에 삼성은 1.36조를 AI 인프라에 베팅했다. 단기 수급은 나쁘지만, 삼성의 이번 투자는 반도체 부품 공급자를 넘어 AI 인프라 생태계의 주체로 도약하겠다는 선언이다. 엔비디아·KKR과 어깨를 나란히 한 점, 전 AWS CEO가 이끄는 팀에 합류한 점에서 장기적 AI 밸류체인 재편 신호로 읽힌다.

코스피 6,800선은 단기 지지선 테스트 구간. 외국인 매도가 진정되고 美금리가 안정화된다면 7,000선 회복 시도는 가능하나, FOMC 여파와 10월 PCE·CPI 발표까지 변동성 장세가 이어질 전망이다.

_오늘 저녁 조중만 김현석님 약속 — 좋은 시간 보내시길 바랍니다, 형!_

articles.headline: Treasury Yields Climb to Highest Level in Nearly Two Decades
articles.body: The yield on the 10-year Treasury note rose to its highest level in nearly two decades, pressuring stocks and housing as investors brace for a prolonged high-rate era.

articles.headline: OpenAI Halts New Model Over Safety Concerns
articles.body: OpenAI scrapped the release of a new artificial-intelligence model after safety reviews, a rare setback for the company at the center of the AI boom.

articles.headline: Nvidia Announces Record $150 Billion Buyback
articles.body: Nvidia said it would buy back a record $150 billion of its own stock, a sign of confidence even as questions mount over the sustainability of AI spending.

articles.headline: AMD to Acquire AI Startup World Labs for $8.2 Billion
articles.body: Chipmaker AMD agreed to acquire the AI startup World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, for $8.2 billion as it challenges Nvidia in artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: Oil Prices Fall as Iran Chokehold on Hormuz Eases
articles.body: Crude prices tumbled as fears of a disruption to the Strait of Hormuz receded, offering relief to consumers and central banks battling inflation.

articles.headline: States Weigh Gas-Tax Holidays as Diesel Prices Hit Records
articles.body: With diesel prices at record highs, state lawmakers are weighing gas-tax holidays ahead of the midterms, a sign of the political sting of energy inflation.

articles.headline: Americans Feel Worse About the Economy Than During the Pandemic
articles.body: A new survey finds Americans feel worse about the economy than at the depths of the pandemic, with inflation and high borrowing costs eroding confidence.

articles.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Rises to Highest Level in Nearly Two Decades
articles.body: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level in nearly two decades, ratcheting up borrowing costs across the economy and weighing on markets.

articles.headline: Record High Diesel Prices Have States Weighing Gas-Tax Holidays Before Midterms
articles.body: As diesel hits record highs, state legislatures are considering gas-tax holidays before the midterm elections, reflecting the political pressure of energy costs.

articles.headline: How China Is Conquering High-Tech Markets Once Controlled by the West
articles.body: China is rapidly capturing high-technology markets once dominated by Western firms, from AI to advanced manufacturing, reshaping global competition.

articles.headline: Student Loan Borrowers Get More Time to Enroll in Autopay
articles.body: The government extended the deadline for student-loan borrowers to enroll in autopay and claim a debt discount, easing a transition for millions of Americans.

articles.headline: Nvidia's Record Buyback Signals AI Cash Machine Rolls On
articles.body: Nvidia's record $150 billion share buyback underscores the torrent of cash its AI chips generate, even as analysts question the durability of the boom.

articles.headline: OpenAI Launches New AI Personal Assistant
articles.body: OpenAI unveiled a new AI personal assistant, marking a deeper push into consumer software as the company races to turn its models into everyday products.

articles.headline: Nvidia Launches Record $150bn Share Buyback
articles.body: Nvidia announced a record $150 billion share buyback, returning windfall profits to investors as demand for its AI chips shows no sign of slowing.

articles.headline: AMD to Buy Fei-Fei Li's AI Start-up for $8bn
articles.body: AMD agreed to buy World Labs, the AI start-up co-founded by Fei-Fei Li, for $8 billion, intensifying the semiconductor industry's battle for AI supremacy.

articles.headline: Meta Launches Enterprise AI Business Seeking to Cash In on Vast Spending
articles.body: Meta launched an enterprise AI business, as Mark Zuckerberg opens a new front in his effort to turn massive technology investment into profits.

articles.headline: Corporate America Embraces Cheaper 'Open' AI Models
articles.body: US companies are increasingly turning to cheaper open-source AI models to cut costs, challenging the pricing power of frontier-model developers.

articles.headline: Treasury Yields Push Higher Despite Falling Oil
articles.body: US Treasury yields kept climbing even as oil prices fell, underscoring how entrenched inflation expectations have become in bond markets.
